rows.en: Gorge in Asia
rows.note: official subtitle kept, converted to ASCII

rows.en: In the Federation Forces' Asia Command,
the Kojima Battalion's 08th MS Team leader
Shiro Amada was on the trail of
a giant, unidentified mobile armor
that had been haunting the region.
This mobile armor's immense power
posed a grave threat to the Federation Forces.
After investigating, the 08th MS Team found
a gorge that seemed to be its test site,
set a trap, and waited for the mobile armor.
And so, several days passed...
Side 3's fallen noble Sakhalin siblings,
striving to restore their house,
labored on a Zeon weapons project,
the "Apsaras Project."
Designed by her ailing brother Ginias:
Mobile Armor "Apsaras."
rows.note: row is shared: also line 3 of mp_cn_0803 (opening line, followed by S01775). Written as a stand-alone label so it reads in both scenes; S01775 refers back with 'its'

rows.en: Becoming its test pilot,
Aina served him with total devotion, but
a young Federation Forces officer she met by chance,
Shiro Amada, moved her heart.
A chain of coincidences
would shake the fates of Aina and Shiro
ever more deeply.
Ruin city in Asia
rows.note: official subtitle kept as written, converted to ASCII

rows.en: Having uncovered its development base,
the Federation Forces resolved to attack it.
The 08th MS Team, dug in amid the deserted city,
stood guard over the Guntank unit as it
launched a long-range attack.
The desperate garrison troops
and Shiro's team, with the modified MS "Ez8,"
now begin their battle.
The Apsaras development base was located
by the Federation Forces; an all-out attack began.
The garrison troops try to escape.
Let at least the sick and wounded escape -
rows.note: Aina's wish given as indirect thought, picked up by 'so wished' in S01787

rows.en: so wished Aina Sakhalin. Seeing this,
her guardian, long in the Sakhalins' service,
the soldier Norris Packard,
sorties to cut a path through the enemy.
Side 6 "Libot"
rows.note: game subtitle spells 'Ribot'; glossary (wiki) has Libot, wiki wins

rows.en: December, Universal Century 0079.
In a colony of neutral Side 6,
a new Gundam was being tested.
Learning of this, the Zeon forces
sent in a strike team to destroy it.
Suddenly, tearing through the city at night,
a Zeon assault mobile suit attacks.
rows.note: number unmarked in JP; singular (canon: the Kampfer attacks alone)

rows.en: The Federation Forces mobile suits sent to defend
were destroyed one after another,
and the enemy was about to reach the base...
The pilot testing the Gundam,
a young woman,
Christina Mackenzie,
was ordered to intercept.
In the neutral colony of Side 6,
a new Gundam was being tested -
learning of this, the Zeon forces
plotted its destruction.
With an infantry strike squad
and an assault MS in a two-stage attack,
charging in, ready to die, was
the Cyclops Team. But
the unit was wiped out, save for rookie Bernie.
Bernie tried to run away, but
for Chris, whom he loved, and the boy
Al, like a little brother to him, he stood firm.
Unless the Gundam was destroyed,
a Zeon warship would fire
a nuke at this colony as planned -
and Bernie knew it.
To protect the people of the colony,
for his own pride...
in the Zaku he and Al repaired together,
Bernie now sorties.
Later to be called Operation Rubicon,
rows.note: modifies the next slice's first row (S01828, the Zeon raid on the Alex)

decisions: Narration tense follows the Japanese: past where the source is past, historic present where it is present (S01780-S01790, S01798-S01799, S01826).
Where English word order needs it, a phrase moves to the next row of the same sentence (S01752/S01754, S01775/S01776, S01813/S01814, S01819/S01822); no rows merged or split.

Glossary forms used: Federation Forces, Zeon forces, 08th MS Team, Cyclops Team, Aina Sakhalin, Ginias, Norris Packard, Christina Mackenzie, Chris, Bernie, Side 3, Side 6, Universal Century, Operation Rubicon.
Rows with long English lines (vs 2.4x JP guide): S01751, S01756, S01769, S01777, S01781, S01784, S01800, S01815, S01818 - orchestrator to measure.
uncertain: S01761/S01787/S01788: Sakhalin used for the family name per glossary en (game romanizes Sahalim, wiki Sahalin) - confirm the family-name form matches Aina's surname project-wide.
S01766: shared row in two intros (0802 line 8, 0803 line 3); chose label form 'Mobile Armor "Apsaras."' to fit both - check it reads well in 0802 after S01765's colon.
S01764/S01766/S01783: 'Apsaras' (base name) and 'Apsaras Project' not in glossary; glossary has Apsaras II/III and 'Apsaras development project'.
S01751: 'Kojima Battalion' not in glossary (Kojima attested on the official site).
S01778: 'Guntank' not in glossary; used the standard spelling.
S01792: wrote 'Libot' per glossary although the game's own subtitle reads 'Ribot'.
S01799: assault MS made singular (Kampfer) - JP does not mark number.
S01768: inferred that Aina's devotion is to her brother Ginias ('served him').
S01818: Al not in excerpt; used 'Al' (Alfred Izuruha, official site).
